hypothesis.name: activation-conditioned residual paging
hypothesis.algebra: W x = W_CQ3 x + sum over selected input groups g of (W_source - W_CQ3)_g x_g
hypothesis.selector: select a fixed number of groups using ||x_g||_2 times the precomputed Frobenius norm ||R_g||_F; selection never reads residual weights
hypothesis.reason: v81 shows that permanently deleting complete MLP precision modes breaks reasoning, while v23 proves that retaining those modes in Q4 preserves capability; conditional residual traffic tests whether those modes can remain exact but cold for most token-group pairs
hypothesis.novelty_status: unassessed; this is a falsification screen, not a novelty claim

upper_bound_status.residual_values: exact BF16 source minus exact deployed trained-CQ3 weights
upper_bound_status.why_optimistic: a deployable residual must be quantized and packed; exact BF16 residual execution can only overstate attainable recovery
upper_bound_status.why_failure_is_material: if exact residual values selected by a deployable no-residual-read bound cannot recover the error at ten-percent traffic, a quantized implementation of this geometry cannot
upper_bound_status.why_pass_is_not_promotion: a pass requires fresh prompts, residual quantization, complete-model quality, and native-kernel evidence

next_if_passed: repeat the same frozen selector on fresh prompts, then quantize the residual pages and construct one complete dynamic artifact
next_if_failed: close input-group residual paging at throughput-relevant traffic; do not tune the budget or layer set
claim_boundary: Architecture-contaminated exact-residual upper-bound screen across nine representative operators. It cannot establish complete-model quality, speed, energy, novelty, or a scientific breakthrough.
